description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class, responsible for handling approval requests in an execution approval gateway within a macOS application. It manages subscription to a gateway stream, processes approval requests, determines if prompts should be presented to the user based on security policies and session information, and resolves approval decisions accordingly.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages approval prompts for execution requests, including subscription to a gateway, processing incoming approval requests, and presenting prompts to the user when necessary.

classes.name: GatewayApprovalRequest
classes.description: A data structure representing an approval request received from the gateway, including identifiers, timestamp, and the request payload.

classes.name: PresentationDecision
classes.description: Model for the decision on whether to prompt the user, including flags for prompting and presentation feasibility, along with security policies and allowlist entries.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the process by subscribing to the gateway stream of approval requests.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Continuously listens for incoming approval requests and handles them asynchronously.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Processes an individual push event received from the gateway stream, decoding and deciding whether to prompt or auto-approve.

methods.name: shouldPresent(request:)
methods.description: Determines if a prompt should be presented based on current session, security policies, and other contextual factors.

methods.name: fallbackDecision(request:askFallback:allowlist:)
methods.description: Computes a fallback approval decision based on the request, fallback policy, and allowlist matching.

methods.name: fallbackResolution(for:)
methods.description: Resolves the command execution path or executable name from the request for allowlist matching.

methods.name: firstToken(from:)
methods.description: Extracts the first token (executable name) from the command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent(mode:activeSession:requestSession:lastInputSeconds:thresholdSeconds:)
methods.description: Determines whether the session conditions warrant prompting the user.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the seconds since the last input event to assist in session activity assessment.
